create_logger_for_rl_training: create a Logger instance with a log directory and TensorBoard support for RL training metrics
log_scalar_metrics: log scalar values like episode_reward or actor_loss to both TensorBoard and JSON log files
log_model_parameters: log model parameter weight and bias histograms to TensorBoard for debugging training
log_training_images: log training or eval images to TensorBoard using the log_image method
dump_metrics_to_console: dump accumulated train and eval metrics to console and JSON log files at each step
